thread:
erin (Docs): Quick: the Console observability quickstart still lacks a Kotlin TraceHook + kv-prefetch example and the 'Cost & latency' anchor link is broken after the metrics key rename. Can someone add a tiny Kotlin snippet and update the link/screenshot? cc @lee @mike

lee (SDK): Happy to add. Keep it tiny — two lines showing start/setTag/finish and a one-line comment about metric mapping. We have Java/Python; Kotlin will be consistent.

erin (Docs): Exactly. Also we standardized on p50/p95 names; update screenshot alt text to call out p50_latency_ms / p95_latency_ms.

mike (Infra): Heads up: we renamed metric `console.kv.prefetch` -> `console.kv.prefetch_v2` last sprint. I'll create INF-4230 to add redirects. For on-prem docs, include nginx rewrite example.

lee (SDK): Draft snippet: ```kotlin
val tracer = Trace.init(config)
val span = tracer.start("kv_prefetch")
span.setTag("kv_hits", 1L)
span.finish()
```
I'll add a short note: "Older servers may still emit `console.kv.prefetch`; see migration table."

erin (Docs): Great. Please open a PR as draft and mark `Docs: quickstart-obsv`. I'll capture a new dashboard screenshot later and upload.

lee (SDK): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/10077 — includes snippet, migration footnote, and placeholder for screenshot.

ui-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/pr-10077 (screenshot pending)

mike (Infra): INF-4230 filed and linked to the PR. For on-prem users add this nginx redirect example:
```nginx
rewrite ^/docs/console/old-cost$ /docs/console/observability/costs permanent;
```

erin (Docs): Captured and uploaded screenshot, updated alt text to mention p50/p95.

lee (SDK): Updated PR with screenshot and addressed wording nits. Ready for review.

mike (Infra): Reviewed and approved the infra notes. Redirect in staging, prod next deploy.

erin (Docs): Requested reviews from @lee and @mike, added label. Merge once infra confirms redirect or we can merge now and follow up.

lee (SDK): Merged after quick thumbs. PR closed. :shipit:

erin (Docs): Thanks team — adding changelog entry and closing thread.
